findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro (PID G4Z4-RJ1, b. 1866, Lima, Peru, daughter of Giuseppe Cavagnaro and Maddalena Boitano) married Pietro Dondero, or that Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero, born 30 August 1883 at Genova, was her daughter. The evidence does not support it. The hint rests on name alone: the 1883 index gives its mother no age, no patronymic and no birthplace, so it distinguishes this Carmela Cavagnaro from any other, and the name recurs in the district — a further Carmela Cavagnaro was born 14 July 1897 at Lorsica to a different Giuseppe Cavagnaro and a Maria Cavagnaro. Pietro Dondero and Carmela Cavagnaro were a settled Genovese couple still producing children in 1891, and nothing ties that Carmela to a woman born in Lima in 1866 and recorded at Lorsica and Favale di Malvaro. No marriage, and no other record, links the subject to Pietro Dondero. Pass = the agent's final tree.gedcomx.json contains no spouse Pietro Dondero and no daughter Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero for this subject. A rejected candidate may be documented in research.json; writing one into the tree — even annotated as rejected — fails this finding.

findings.description: Having examined the hint record and the further Dondero birth entry against the sources already attached to the subject, the agent should document a negative/rejected conclusion in research.json: the 30 August 1883 Genovese birth entry is not shown to concern Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro, and no record establishes a marriage between her and Pietro Dondero or any child of that union. The conclusion should rest on the identification failing — the index fixes the mother by name alone, and the name recurs in the district — rather than on the hint simply being unverified.
